# Corterm provenance

Copied from the MV2 project at `/Users/echo/workspace/V2ex.Maui2/vendor/adaptive_platform_ui` on 2026-10-25.

Upstream: https://github.com/berkaycatak/adaptive_platform_ui (MIT, see LICENSE).
This copy includes MV2's fixed toolbar registry, Duo vertical bars, native glass capsules, overflow menus, and system vertical-edge bridge. MV2 remains unchanged.

Corterm exposes the existing chrome scope, title metrics, Duo pose and glass capsule classes through the public Dart entrypoint for the Material scaffold adapter. Native behavior is copied from MV2.
